recipe.ghg_note: EXIOBASE: mass-reported gases use EDGAR-compatible AR5 GWP100 (CH4=28). HFC/PFC already in source CO2eq retain their original characterisation; its IPCC basis is not independently verified. Production accounts and EDGAR territorial totals have different boundaries.

notes.gross_output: Native MARIO X for IOTs and Xc for SUTs, summed over producing nodes. Gross output includes intermediate production at multiple stages and is not GDP.
notes.domestic_use: Domestic-origin use within the same native region only: matching origin and destination regions in Z and Y (IOT) or U and Yc (SUT). Intermediate and final uses enter once; signed source adjustments are retained.
notes.final_demand: Final demand by consumer region from Y (IOT) or Yc (SUT). Domestic and Imported identify the supplying row region relative to that consumer. A shared SNA category vocabulary is used; native combined categories are never split or duplicated. Households + NPISH combines the observed household and NPISH source columns where separately supplied.
notes.value_added_footprint: Value added generated by domestic and foreign producers to meet the selected final demand. Consumer columns are retained throughout; production-origin totals are independently reconciled.
notes.ghg_footprint: Allocable production-chain emissions supported by final demand, plus direct final-demand emissions where supplied. Domestic/foreign identifies the production origin relative to the native consumer region. Zero-output production emissions are reported as a separate unallocated residual. Unallocated production emissions: 396,647.958 t CO2eq globally (0.000966% of the reviewed production total); kept by production origin, with no consumer allocation. EXIOBASE: mass-reported gases use EDGAR-compatible AR5 GWP100 (CH4=28). HFC/PFC already in source CO2eq retain their original characterisation; its IPCC basis is not independently verified. Production accounts and EDGAR territorial totals have different boundaries.
notes.ghg_trade: Global upstream emissions embodied in gross intermediate and final trade. Each border crossing can include emissions counted at earlier stages, so this is not a final-consumption footprint. Domestic pairs and direct final-user emissions are excluded from international flows. EXIOBASE: mass-reported gases use EDGAR-compatible AR5 GWP100 (CH4=28). HFC/PFC already in source CO2eq retain their original characterisation; its IPCC basis is not independently verified. Production accounts and EDGAR territorial totals have different boundaries. Unallocated zero-output production GHG: 396,647.958 t CO2eq globally.
